papers.name: animal or cell result stated for humans
papers.faithful: In rats, GLP-1 receptors in the locus coeruleus help control food intake, and blocking them there reduced GLP-1-induced nausea-like behaviour.
papers.overstated: In people taking GLP-1 drugs, GLP-1 receptors in the locus coeruleus help control food intake, and blocking them there reduces nausea.

papers.name: prior finding stated as this study's result
papers.faithful: Earlier preclinical studies, cited as background, reported that metformin reduces T-cell exhaustion in tumours and strengthens PD-1 blockade.
papers.overstated: This phase II trial showed that metformin reduces T-cell exhaustion in tumours and strengthens PD-1 blockade.

papers.name: null result stated as an effect
papers.faithful: In colon cancer stem cells, blocking miR-342-3p did not significantly change cell viability or apoptosis, although CD133 mRNA expression rose.
papers.overstated: In colon cancer stem cells, blocking miR-342-3p clearly changed cell viability and apoptosis, and CD133 mRNA expression rose.
